41005.notes: Oregon redeemable-deed / tax-foreclosure then surplus-sale county (ORS ch. 312 foreclosure; ORS ch. 275 disposition). Deposit non-refundable once accepted; balance due within two business days. Personal/business checks and money orders not accepted. County employees/officials restricted under ORS 275.088.

22019.notes: Louisiana redeemable-deed / adjudicated-property parish. Two distinct paths: (1) Calcasieu Parish Sheriff judicial Sheriff’s Sales moved fully online via Bid4Assets (CPSOSheriff) with $1,000 bidder deposit — mortgage/judgment executions, not the pure tax-adjudication auction; (2) Adjudicated (tax) property sold by the Police Jury — next adjudicated auction Sept 22, 2026, Police Jury Meeting Room, 1015 Pithon St, Lake Charles; finalized list ~Aug 21, 2026. LA redemption ~3 years at 1%/month + 5% penalty class of rights. Research which path a target parcel is on before bidding.

24043.notes: Maryland tax-lien certificate county. Washington County Treasurer conducts an annual in-person tax sale the first Tuesday in June at 9:00 a.m. at 35 W. Washington St., Hagerstown (rear of County Office Building) — not Bid4Assets despite some third-party sites. High-bid auction of liens; redemption interest 6% per annum. Foreclosure of right of redemption may start after 6 months + 1 day; certificate void if action not filed within 2 years. High-bid premium refunded without interest on redemption or on deed delivery per TP Art. rules.

auctionPlatform.label: Washington County Treasurer — Annual Tax Sale (County Office Building)

24043.auctionFrequency: Annually, first Tuesday in June, 9:00 a.m. Eastern
24043.depositRules: Pre-register at Treasurer’s Office with Tax Sale Bidder Registration Application + W-9; registration closes 3:00 p.m. Friday before sale (forms available ~April 23 each year). Pay full amount due for all winning bids by specified sale-day deadline or be excluded and re-award to next bidder. Buyer assumes risk of void sales (bankruptcy, pre-sale payment, assessment errors) — exclusive remedy is refund of purchase price/premium without interest.

24043.quietTitle: After decree and tax deed, title companies often require additional curative/quiet-title work before free-and-clear insurance.

25015.notes: Massachusetts municipal tax-title system (G.L. c. 60) — no single county-run auction. Cities/towns take tax title, then may assign/foreclose via Land Court and sell surplus. Hampshire’s largest municipalities include Amherst and Northampton; each Treasurer/Collector runs its own process and any public sale. Investor must track individual town advertisements. Bid-down interest from 16% class of rights on assignments where used. Expect thin, sporadic inventory versus large metro counties.

auctionPlatform.label: Confirm with municipality (e.g. Amherst & Northampton Treasurer/Collector)

25015.auctionFrequency: Irregular — only when a city/town advertises tax-title assignments or surplus sales
25015.depositRules: Set entirely by the selling municipality’s notice (deposit %, certified funds, Land Court foreclosure status). Contact Amherst Treasurer/Collector or Northampton Treasurer/Collector for any active tax-title lists before assuming a county-wide sale exists.

25015.quietTitle: Land Court foreclosure aims at marketable title, but many buyers still budget additional curative work before conventional finance.

28047.notes: Mississippi tax-lien (certificate) county. Harrison County Tax Collector sells annually online on GovEase the last Monday of August, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m., continuing daily until complete (no lunch breaks). Two judicial districts (Gulfport/Biloxi lists) — funds cannot transfer between districts. Overbids earn no interest (interest only on face value at 1.5%/month statutory class). 2-year redemption via Chancery Clerk Land Redemption. Leasehold parcels sold at end of sale — research carefully.

auctionPlatform.label: GovEase — Harrison County MS tax sale

28047.auctionFrequency: Annually, last Monday in August (multi-day until complete)
28047.depositRules: Register + W-9 on GovEase each year. Deposit certified funds (cashier’s check, cash, money order) at Tax Collector’s Gulfport office up to intended bid total before sale day; Visa/MC/Discover accepted with ~2.25% non-refundable fee. Designate Judicial District 1 vs 2 when depositing. Personal checks with bank letters not accepted. Recommend funding before sale day — cannot bid until deposit applied.

28047.survivingLiens: Tax sale creates a lien; owner remains legal owner during 2-year redemption. Mortgages and other liens remain until mature tax deed process. Federal liens survive. Special assessments (city cleanup) can be in the sale amount. Overbid is not refunded and earns no interest.
28047.quietTitle: After maturity and tax deed, quiet title is commonly required for marketable insured title on MS Gulf Coast parcels.
